narrative: 展示包裹着一种情感的容器。人物依然留在原地，而世界将其收归己有。
与变焦拉远不同，因为摄影机在后退，家具和门框会真正经过镜头。如果你需要的是让土地占据主导的高空航拍，或者一个固定机位的光学变宽会显得更抽离，那么这就不是合适的工具。
要明确这次后退代表的是谁的视点。
how: 在推轨、斯坦尼康，或虚拟摄影机上向后位移。固定焦距。
构图确定宽景的结束画面，让新出现的墙壁具有意义。提示词：缓慢的拉镜头，亲密感逐渐扩展为环境，人物依然留在原地，而世界将其收归己有。
when: 用它来展示包裹一种情感的容器。具体场景：一个哭泣的近景覆盖镜头不断后退，直到空荡荡的公寓成为这句“话”的全部内容。
不要拉镜头拉到一片空白的天空，却没有任何新的信息。
vs: 推轨后拉（Dolly Out）是在人眼高度、用带轮设备完成这项工作。航拍拉远（Aerial Pullback）则会离开地面。
慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）在不移动的情况下揭示语境。拉镜头则是一种通用的、物理或虚拟的后退：容器之所以出现，是因为我们后退了。
examples_film: 《楚门的世界》（The Truman Show）通过离开亲密的画面，揭示出这个被构建的世界。《幕后玩家》（The Player）把后退当作更长的运动长句的一部分，揭示片场作为一个系统的运作方式。
把它们当作“容器语法”来学习，而不是照搬的场景设置。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是慢速变焦拉远。破绽在于房间画面变大，却没有任何视差。
解决办法：让摄影机真正远离，焦距固定，新的建筑结构从画面边缘经过。

faq.q: 电影中的拉镜头（Pull Out）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机后退，因机位本身远离而在主体周围打开空间，而不仅仅是靠镜头变宽实现的。

faq.q: 拉镜头（Pull Out）与推轨后拉（Dolly Out）的区别
faq.a: 推轨后拉特指带轮设备沿轨道完成的路径。拉镜头则是更宽泛的后退统称，可以用斯坦尼康、虚拟摄影机，或轨道来实现。两者都应该呈现视差；而变焦拉远不会。

faq.q: 什么时候该用拉镜头（Pull Out）？
faq.a: 当一种情感周围的房间、街道或系统需要成为下一句“话”时使用。不要把它用作航拍式的收尾镜头。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写拉镜头（Pull Out）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：缓慢的拉镜头，摄影机远离，环境逐渐进入画面，不使用光学变焦。并说明必须出现的那个“容器”是什么。

narrative: Show the container around a feeling. The person remains while the world claims them.

Unlike a zoom out, furniture and doorways can pass the lens because the camera is retreating. It is the wrong tool when you needed a high aerial to let land win, and the wrong tool when a locked optical widen would be more detached.
Define whose viewpoint the retreat represents.
how: Translate backward on dolly, Steadicam, or virtual camera. Fix focal length.
Compose the wide end so the new walls mean something. Prompt a slow pull out, intimacy widening into environment, the person remaining while the world claims them.
when: Use it to show the container around a feeling. Concrete beat: a crying close coverage that retreats until the empty apartment is the sentence.
Do not pull out into a blank sky with no new fact.
vs: A Dolly Out is this job on wheels at human height. An Aerial Pullback leaves the ground.
A Slow Zoom Out discloses context without walking. Pull out is the generic physical or virtual retreat: the container appears because we backed up.
examples_film: The Truman Show discloses the constructed world by leaving the intimate frame. The Player uses retreat as part of longer moving sentences that reveal the lot as a system.
Treat them as container grammar, not as setups to duplicate.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom Out. The tell is no parallax as the room grows.
The fix: move the camera away, fixed lens, new architecture passing the edges.

faq.q: What is Pull Out in film?
faq.a: It is a camera retreat that opens space around a subject because the station point moves away, not because the lens widens alone.
Dolly out names the wheeled path. Pull out is the broader retreat job and may be Steadicam, virtual, or track. Both should show parallax; a zoom out will not.

faq.q: When should I use Pull Out?
faq.a: When the room, street, or system around a feeling is the next sentence. Do not use it as an aerial chapter-close.

faq.q: How do I prompt Pull Out for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write slow pull out, camera moving away, environment entering, no optical zoom. Name the container that must appear.
